notes: REF-BM-02: metadata endpoint collects title, description, and favicon but never og:image/preview image. REF-BM-04: url/title/description/tags/collection editable, but note is not (no note field exists). REF-BM-06: new saves always create a fresh id (Date.now()); no duplicate-url detection or convergence to editing. REF-BM-10: tags are a plain comma text input with no autocomplete of existing tags. REF-BM-11: card tags are non-interactive spans; no click-a-tag-to-filter (only collections and free-text search). REF-BM-12: search haystack covers title/description/domain/tags but not note (absent) and only domain rather than full url. REF-BM-14: tags stored without '#'; '#tag' syntax yields no match, no special handling. REF-BM-15: substring search only; no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match parsing. REF-BM-20: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-21: no bulk-to-filter scope action. REF-BM-23: no note field or markdown rendering. REF-BM-24: no local HTML/PDF snapshot. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-26/27/28: 'Archive' nav button is an inert stub; no archived flag, no hide-from-list, no reversible-vs-delete distinction, no archive list. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no export. REF-BM-32: 'Settings' button is inert; sort exists transiently but no persisted default sort, displayed-items, or font-size settings.
